Located within an Airbnb/short-term rental zone, the property may offer additional possibilities for an investor looking to capitalize on Niagara Falls' strong tourism market.

Seller prefers to sell 1306 Whitney Ave. with 1301, 1303 & 1305 13th Street, Niagara Falls (B1714411) creating an opportunity to acquire multiple properties in close proximity. Bring your vision, contractor, and renovation plans and explore the potential of this investment package. Property is being sold in as-is condition.

As Is sale, no survey or search will be completed, nor a cross-connection inspection will be completed by the seller.
